description: This file defines a modern design system for a medical exam prep application, including color palettes, typography, spacing, border radii, shadows, and functions to generate CSS styles and styled HTML components such as metric cards and badges.

methods.name: get_global_css
methods.description: Returns a string containing global CSS styles for the application, including font imports, scrollbar styling, layout, and component styles.

methods.name: create_metric_card
methods.description: Generates an HTML string for a styled metric card component, optionally including a delta indicator.

methods.name: create_stat_badge
methods.description: Creates an HTML string for a small stat badge with a label and value.
